messages:
marta_cs: Heads up — Zephyr AI asked for a temporary APAC throughput boost + IP allowlist for an upcoming pilot tomorrow morning. They want +2x rate for 72h and a CIDR add for their peering node.
raj_sre: copy — do we have headroom on apac clusters for a short burst? what GPUs/instances are they on?
marta_cs: They're on hosted, routed to apac-1 region, default model gpt-small-open. Customer provided source IP 203.0.113.42/32 and says they'll use a single egress IP for the pilot.
olivia_onboard: tagging infra-bot to open a provisioning ticket. We also need to capture renewal note — Zephyr is in trial, pilot success -> likely conversion.
infra-bot: Ticket #INF-8721 created for temporary rate adjustment and CIDR allowlist. Assignee: raj_sre. ETA requested.
raj_sre: I'll check capacity. Quick ask: do we want to implement a per-customer rate window extension or a temporary per-IP override? prefer per-customer for tracking but per-IP is faster.
jamie_pm: Given trial -> renewal risk/opportunity, prefer per-customer so billing/metrics show usage. But we need it live by 04:00 UTC tomorrow. If per-customer takes longer, do per-IP now and migrate.
marta_cs: Agreed. Start per-IP as quick path, then backfill per-customer. Document on account for renewal.
raj_sre: Ok. I'll push a per-IP allowlist and a temporary rate window: `rate_limit: 200req/min` (current 100req/min) with `expires: 72h`. Will also add a tag `zephyr-pilot-2234` to metrics.
olivia_onboard: Please also add region routing override so we keep them in apac-1. Pilot origin is APAC and they must stay there.
raj_sre: Will set routing policy `prefer: apac-1` on their customer id for the window. Note: if apac capacity degrades we'll fallback to global-1 per usual SLO.
jamie_pm: QA checklist for CS: confirm config applied, confirm they can hit endpoints from 203.0.113.42, and capture sample latency & token cost. Also send brief runbook to customer for escalation.
marta_cs: I'll message them as soon as infra confirms. Raj — can you confirm when applied?
raj_sre: Applied per-IP allowlist + temp rate window = deployed (logs: `ALLOW_ADD 203.0.113.42/32`, `RATE_WINDOW_SET zephyr-cust 200rpm expires+72h`). Routing override set to apac-1.
infra-bot: INF-8721 status updated -> done by raj_sre at 2234567915.
olivia_onboard: Verified from Zephyr's side: they can connect and see increased throughput. They reported 25% lower latency from apac edge.
jamie_pm: Great. Marta please log this as a renewal opportunity and schedule a 2-week post-pilot check-in. Also capture any quality/regression notes; if they expand we'll propose Dedicated.
marta_cs: Logged in CRM (note id ZP-PLT-334). Will also send them the escalation runbook and ask for any post-pilot metrics.
raj_sre: One follow-up: we'll auto-revoke the per-IP rule at expiration; I'll create a reminder to coordinate if they need extension.
marta_cs: thanks everyone :thumbsup: — closing thread after I confirm post-pilot meeting on calendar.
